messages:
marc: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands about the headcount reprioritization. Recording + slides: https://redwood.internal/all-hands/1845001234 :loudspeaker:
sophia: TL;DR: we27re reallocating open hiring to focus on Platform Reliability and Dedicated delivery for enterprise customers. This is a shift in priorities, not a hiring freeze forever.
alexa: Operational change: effective immediately we27re placing non-critical external reqs into a temporary hold state while we re-evaluate priorities (expected review window: 10 business days). Critical exceptions can be requested.
devon: Managers need concrete counts to plan. How many reqs are affected and where are slots moving?
sophia: High-level numbers: company ~150 headcount. We27re tightening hiring spend ~7% for the quarter (~10 FTE equivalents). Of those, ~6-8 slots are being funneled toward Platform Reliability / Dedicated engineering work. Exact paused list + owners coming in the next update.
cheng: Clarify: will there be layoffs or is this strictly pausing/deferring external hires?
sophia: No company-wide layoffs tied to this announcement. Primary actions: pause/deferral of external hiring and targeted reallocation of budget. If any role needs other actions, we'll handle that privately with People Ops.
paul: Recruiting process: all open requisitions will be marked `on-hold` by default. Managers who believe a req is mission-critical should submit an exception ticket in #recruiting-approvals with a short justification (impact, timeline, blocker risk). Tag requests with `critical-hire` or `inference-impact` to speed review. Expect a 48-72h response. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
recruiting-bot: Helpful link: https://redwood.internal/hr/headcount-q2 27manager petition27 form and FAQ.
marc: Manager talking points you can reuse in 1:1s: ``Hey — leadership is shifting hire capacity toward enterprise reliability work. Some external hires will be paused for a short review window. If your role is affected we27ll follow up privately and discuss internal mobility and timing.``
devon: Internal mobility: can folks apply into Platform Reliability or Dedicated roles? What's the timeline?
paul: Yes — internal transfers are encouraged. Internal applicants are fast-tracked; flag apps as `internal-fasttrack`. Hiring managers: aim for a one-week interview turnaround for internal candidates.
cheng: Contractors & renewals? Several teams rely on short-term contractors.
sophia: Contractors will be reviewed case-by-case. Expect some non-essential renewals to be deferred; business-critical contractors can be extended with approval from Finance + Eng leads.
alexa: Research/ML nuance: we will continue to prioritize hires that directly enable inference performance and cost improvements (runtime, quantization, Dedicated integrations). Exploratory hires with unclear delivery impact may be deferred. Route inference-impact hires through recruiting-approvals and tag `inference-impact`.
devon: Any changes to leveling or interview loop structure?
sophia: No changes to leveling. We will request an infra/product reviewer for Dedicated-related loops and require concise impact justification for approvals.
people-ops: Resources for managers + individuals: https://redwood.internal/hr/headcount-q2 (FAQ, scripts, petition form) and https://redwood.internal/hr/severance-q2 (legal contacts, if needed). People Ops are available for confidential conversations.
marc: Next steps: 1) paused list + owners posted in #all-hands-updates by EOD, 2) 10-business-day review window, 3) final reallocation decisions and org sketch within two weeks.
paul: I'll post the paused-req spreadsheet and owners shortly. Managers, please prepare exception petitions now if you believe a req should remain open.
sophia: We know this causes uncertainty. We27re aiming for speed and transparency. Please DM People Ops for private concerns. :heart:
marc: Closing thread — will update when paused-list + org sketch are live. Thanks for the thoughtful Qs and patience.
